rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for replying or speaking in an annoyed, impatient manner.

example.english: They were late again, so I said crossly, “Could you be on time for once?”
example.traditional: 佢又遲到，我冇好氣咁話：「你可唔可以準時一次呀？」
example.jyutping: keoi5 jau6 ci4 dou3 ngo5 mou5 hou2 hei3 gam2 waa6 nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 zeon2 si4 jat1 ci3 aa3

rows.note: Use this when the cross manner is conveyed by a harsh or angry tone of voice.

example.english: The boss scolded people crossly in a harsh voice, and the whole shop could hear him.
example.traditional: 老闆惡聲惡氣咁鬧人，成間舖都聽到。
example.jyutping: lou5 baan2 ok3 sing1 ok3 hei3 gam2 naau6 jan4 seng4 gaan1 pou3 dou1 teng1 dou2

rows.note: Use this for a mildly annoyed or irritated manner rather than outright hostility.

example.english: I asked crossly, “Did you forget your keys again?”
example.traditional: 我嬲嬲哋咁問佢：「你係咪又唔記得帶鎖匙？」
example.jyutping: ngo5 nau1 nau1 dei6 gam2 man6 keoi5 nei5 hai6 mai6 jau6 m4 gei3 dak1 daai3 so2 si4
